name: XLE
generation: Documented availability in the official 2021 manufacturer catalogue, not an established first-introduction date. Later 2025 component references are preserved; the historical XCD 11 identity is unchanged.

sources.title: Original microSHIFT 2025 Drivetrain catalogue, archived manufacturer publication, PDF spread 11 / printed page 17: XLE 11 named 1/2×11-speed range, control sets, shared 10/11-speed derailleurs and cassette inventory
microSHIFT 2021 Drivetrain manufacturer catalogue, PDF spread 10, printed pp. 15–16: XLE 11 named 1/2×11-speed range and original inventory, confirming earlier 2021 availability
